job: bind an application-declared projection semantic identity into the durable schema digest and rebuild indexes through one explicit migration
initial_state: empty temporary redb replica bound to schema version 1 with one index identity declaring semantics V1
expectation: a changed projection function under the same index identity and schema version is refused until an explicit resumable migration rebuilds every row
perturbation: reopen the same file with the same IndexId and schema version while declaring semantics V2 and a function whose output differs for the stored document
observations: ProjectionSemantics::version(0) is refused; a nonzero version or an opaque digest is required
reopen with changed semantics returns DatabaseError::Store(StoreError::SchemaMigrationRequired) without touching state
declaring one index identity twice in the target set returns DatabaseError::DuplicateProjection
an opaque digest semantics identity binds and reopens the same schema, while a different digest under the same index and version also requires migration
Database::migrate_schema with the V2 semantics rebuilds the single document in bounded revision-checked pages
the stale V1 value query returns no rows and the V2 value query returns the document
invariant: a persisted reverse-index row set is valid only for the exact schema version and {(IndexId, ProjectionSemantics)} set that produced it
limitations: the journey drives the public embedded facade, not a multi-process deployment
existing databases bound before the digest v1 to v2 change require one explicit migration; there is no silent adoption path by design
